title: Handoff Runbook — Weekly Sync (Aegle private deployment)
content:
Context:
This is my personal weekly prep + live-note scratchpad for the Aegle private deployment handoff cadence. Goal is to capture the sync agenda, current milestone statuses, outstanding blockers (with root cause notes), and clear action items/owners to carry into the customer-facing update. Use this as a single source of quick reference before the 1:1 with Aegle PM and the weekly engineering touchpoint.

Meeting: Aegle Private Deploy — Weekly Eng/Handoff Sync
Audience: Aegle ops lead (Maya), Aegle infra (contractor Samir), Redwood SRE/Installer/Platform reps
Time: Thurs 11:00 PST (30m)
My prep focus: KMS validation, air-gap installer edge cases, HA control plane smoke results, and rollout blast radius plan.

Top-line objective for this week:
- Get KMS integration validated with Aegle's HSM (soft-fail mode) and confirm customer has keys accessible from bastion
- Complete air-gapped installer test cycle on staging-iso-3 and triage two failure classes
- Lock final cutover window proposal and owner list for on-site handoff (tentative week of 2025-02-03)

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick status (5m) — one-line per owner
2) Milestone deep-dive (10m) — KMS, installer, control-plane HA, smoke tests
3) Blockers & triage plan (8m) — who will debug what this week
4) Action items + dates (5m)

Milestone status (owner / ETA / short note):
- KMS/HSM validation: Owner: Mei Chen / ETA: 2025-01-22 / Status: in-progress. Notes: HSM vendor cert chain mismatch on test key import; customer able to create keys but Redwood agent can't fetch key metadata when using mTLS profile. Workaround: soft-fail to local KMS is possible but requires customer sign-off for reduced key-use audit.

- Air-gapped installer end-to-end: Owner: Ibrahim Noor / ETA: 2025-01-24 / Status: flaky. Notes: Two failure classes seen on staging-iso-3: (A) package signature verification fails intermittently when caching layer TTL < 30s (race in downloader); (B) systemd unit ordering causes attempted start of runtime before network namespace mounted. Both reproducible locally.

- HA control plane w/ local LB: Owner: Sofia Park / ETA: 2025-01-21 / Status: blocked -> partial. Notes: Leader election is stable but failover of external LB IP not propagating to VPC route table (customer-side routing policy). We need one scheduled window with Aegle network team to modify route priority.

- Post-deploy smoke + perf baselines: Owner: Lucas Rivera / ETA: 2025-01-27 / Status: pending. Notes: Need final model bundle from ModelOps (PROJ-MODEL-47) to run realistic token throughput tests.

Blockers (what, impact, proposed next step, owner):
1) HSM cert chain mismatch (Mei) — impact: prevents final KMS validation and key retrieval in prod profile; blocks cutover.
   - Root cause hypothesis: Aegle vendor uses a non-standard intermediate CA name; our agent's trust store rejects it.
   - Proposed next step: run import with expanded trust anchors + capture TLS handshake traces; ask vendor to provide cert chain file. Owner: Mei / Due: 2025-01-18

2) Installer package race (Ibrahim) — impact: installer failures on ~30% of staging runs causing unreliable tests; delays all air-gap signoffs.
   - Root cause hypothesis: downloader thread pool doesn't wait for cache warm commit, TTL too aggressive under load.
   - Proposed next step: patch downloader to add explicit commit barrier, add integration test that simulates cache eviction under load. Owner: Ibrahim / Due: 2025-01-20 (patch) + 2025-01-23 (test pass)

3) VPC route propagation (Sofia + Aegle NW) — impact: control plane HA failover not verified; higher blast radius risk.
   - Root cause: customer route priority set to manual override; changes not auto-propagated to standby nodes.
   - Proposed next step: schedule 30m network window with Aegle infra and Redwood SRE to adjust route policy and verify failover. Owner: Sofia to schedule / Due: 2025-01-19

4) Model bundle delayed (ModelOps) — impact: cannot run perf smoke or finalize batching configs.
   - Mitigation: run synthetic token-sized workloads with representative token distributions, but results will be lower fidelity. Owner: Lucas / Due: 2025-01-21 (synth runs)

Action items (clear owner + atomic task):
- Mei: collect full HSM cert chain + provide debug TLS dump (ethereal capture) and share sanitized dump in Confluence. Due 2025-01-18. Linked: JIRA-PD-9221.
- Ibrahim: produce hotfix branch with cache commit barrier + run 10x installer cycles on staging-iso-3; attach logs. Due 2025-01-20. PR: #284.
- Sofia: book 30m routing window with Aegle network team (include Maya and Samir). Due 2025-01-19. Put meeting on calendar and add routing playbook to shared folder.
- Lucas: run synthetic perf smoke (token dist from PROJ-MODEL-47 placeholder) and record baseline numbers (P50/P95 latency, tokens/s, memory). Due 2025-01-21.
- All: prepare 1-slide escalation summary if any blocker remains after next run — deadline 2025-01-23. Owner: Lucas to aggregate.

Risks & mitigations (note for exec sync):
- Risk: KMS delay pushes cutover by > 2 weeks — Mitigation: propose temporary soft-fail keyed to audit window and require explicit customer acceptance; prepare rollback plan.
- Risk: Air-gap installer instability undermines confidence — Mitigation: increase acceptance test runs and add canary node group for initial on-prem rollout.

Customer questions to bring up in sync:
- Will Aegle accept temporary local-KMS soft-fail for a max of 2 weeks if HSM vendor can't deliver chain this week? (We need a yes/no this sync.)
- Can their NW team free 30 min Wed/Thu next week for route policy changes?
- Confirm preferred maintenance window (weekdays 0200-0500 local) for cutover; we tentatively propose 2025-02-05 03:00 local.

Internal reminders / notes to self:
- Add debug flag to agent to force full cert chain logging (disabled by default).
- Re-run failure scenario for installer with TTL=0.1s to reproduce worst-case.
- Coordinate with ModelOps — ping Priya for bundle status; if not ready, request interim artifact by 2025-01-20.

Next sync goals (what I want to report):
- Confirm HSM chain receipt or plan for soft-fail (binary answer)
- Show green installer runs on staging-iso-3 x5
- Confirm scheduled routing window with Aegle NW
- Present preliminary perf numbers or rationale for synthetic fallback

Meeting prep checklist (quick):
- [ ] Upload trimmed TLS dump to Confluence (Mei)
- [ ] Link hotfix PR and CI logs (Ibrahim)
- [ ] Calendar invite for routing window (Sofia)
- [ ] Synthetic perf run artifacts + charts (Lucas)
- [ ] One-slide escalation (Lucas)

Footer: personal note — keep the sync tight (30m). Call out only blockers + decisions. If HSM still unresolved, escalate to delivery lead (Kara) and add to Friday exec checkpoint.

End of scratchpad.
